classification.difficultyReason: Derive the supplied symbolic height expression by linking a right-triangle ratio and sine rule.

content.prompt: From the top of the cliff, the angles of depression of 2 boats at sea that are 0.5 km apart are $55^\circ$ and $33^\circ$. Show that the height of the cliff $h=\dfrac{0.5\sin33^\circ\sin55^\circ}{\sin22^\circ}$

spec.sourceRegion: Question 17 cliff diagram beneath the stem
spec.description: Pale blue-purple cliff at left, irregular blue cliff edge beside a dashed vertical height h, cliff label inside the shaded area, horizontal sea baseline, and two blue sight lines from the cliff top to unmarked boat positions. Dashed horizontal reference at the top; 33° and 55° depression indicators; right-angle square at the foot. Dimension line with endpoint ticks and arrowheads spans only the boat interval below the baseline. No boat icons or point names.
spec.mathematics: Height h is perpendicular to the sea baseline. Near and far sight lines make depression angles 55° and 33° respectively. Their sea endpoints are 0.5 km apart. Stroke #185DAE; cliff fill #B8C2E1; dark labels.

answer.worked:
Let $x$ km be the distance from the observer to the closer boat.
$$\begin{align*}\sin55^\circ&=\frac{h}{x}\\[8pt]x&=\frac{h}{\sin55^\circ}\end{align*}$$
The angle between the sight lines is $55^\circ-33^\circ=22^\circ$. The angle at the farther boat is $33^\circ$ (alternate angles).
By the sine rule,
$$\begin{align*}\frac{0.5}{\sin22^\circ}&=\frac{x}{\sin33^\circ}\\[8pt]\frac{0.5}{\sin22^\circ}&=\frac{h}{\sin55^\circ\sin33^\circ}\\[8pt]h&=\frac{0.5\sin33^\circ\sin55^\circ}{\sin22^\circ}\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
